ember.name: Ember
ember.desc: A ball of fire. Where it lands, the ground burns for a few seconds.

pyre.name: Pyre
pyre.desc: The same fireball, with far less restraint. A wider, longer fire.

spray.name: Spray
spray.desc: A ball of water thrown hard enough to go straight through a line of bodies.

torrent.name: Torrent
torrent.desc: Enough water, moving fast enough, to knock a rank over.

shardshot.name: Shardshot
shardshot.desc: A stone thrown low and hard. It bursts a moment after it lands.

upheaval.name: Upheaval
upheaval.desc: The ground opens where it stops. Slow, and worth the wait.

gust.name: Gust
gust.desc: Fast, light, and it carries whatever it hits backwards with it.

galewind.name: Galewind
galewind.desc: A line of moving air with an edge on it.

eldritch_blast.name: Eldritch Blast
eldritch_blast.desc: A beam of crackling force out of the oldest books. It passes through whatever it strikes and throws the rest back.
eldritch_blast.taught_by: Magister Orrin teaches it at the college in Fernhollow.

magic_missile.name: Magic Missile
magic_missile.desc: Three darts of light that turn after whatever you are fighting. They have never been known to miss.
magic_missile.taught_by: The college in Fernhollow sells the tome.

scorching_ray.name: Scorching Ray
scorching_ray.desc: Three rays of heat in a fan, faster than anything the elements throw.
scorching_ray.taught_by: The college in Fernhollow sells the tome.

hail_of_blades.name: Hail of Blades
hail_of_blades.desc: A moment after the word is said, conjured blades come down on whatever you are fighting and everything beside it.
hail_of_blades.taught_by: The college in Fernhollow sells the tome.

cloud_of_daggers.name: Cloud of Daggers
cloud_of_daggers.desc: A slow orb that bursts into a cloud of spinning knives where it lands, and hangs there cutting for a few seconds.
cloud_of_daggers.taught_by: The college in Fernhollow sells the tome.

thunderwave.name: Thunderwave
thunderwave.desc: A ring of force out of the caster in every direction at once, that throws everything it touches.
thunderwave.taught_by: The college in Fernhollow sells the tome.
